method: Candidate sweep over labeled fast-oscillator windows plus flat/chop controls. Precision/recall count exact index-and-side pivot matches. Floors pin only the frozen threshold in tests/integration_lite.rs; every other number below is evidence, not code.

chop_40.verdict: quiet at the frozen threshold; fires every bar at 50, which is why 50 cannot be trusted for alerts

rise_reversal.shape: climb 60..170 then drop to 60; expected High@7 at threshold 100
rise_reversal.verdict: full score at 100; 50 misses entirely (drop stalls above it), 200 never reached

fall_recovery.shape: slide 40..-120 then recover to 0; expected Low@5 at threshold 100
fall_recovery.verdict: full score at 100; 50 fires one bar late (wrong index, precision 0), 150+ never reached

floors.windows_at_100: precision 1.0 and recall 1.0 on both reversal windows

freeze.fixture: 60-bar integral ramp, native kernels vs Pine drivers (normalizeOsc RSI/CCI length 14, getEIT 0.14)
freeze.verdict: bit-identical on all three series; any widening is a behavior change with a reason

confidence_signals.note: Freeze drivers perform no seam fetches; the count is reported alongside precision/recall and never substitutes for it
